_comment: Recorded latency and cost thresholds for Plethora Pro cloud endpoints and serverless jobs. Update deliberately in the same PR as an intentional architectural or schema change.

auth_session_verify.reason: Auth session token verification (HMAC/JWT or key lookup) must remain sub-100ms.

entitlements_get_snapshot.reason: Entitlements snapshot query hits memory/KV cache; must respond within 50ms P95.

jobs_enqueue.reason: Job submission into cloud worker queue.

sync_push_record.reason: Sync delta chunk push with crypto epoch verification.
